name: Dura-Ace EX direction-system rear freehub
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 321 g in Shimano SI-M-14 for the FH-7261 6-speed, 32-hole, 126 mm OLD rear freehub, explicitly without sprockets or quick-release cam sections. This service-instruction reference is not the catalogue’s QR-unspecified figure; no subtraction is used.
